old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-su3f","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1hbf: initiator passes ciphertext instead of plaintext to transcript_4","description":"The initiator computes TH_4 over CIPHERTEXT_3 instead of PLAINTEXT_3 as required by EDHOC RFC 9528. At edhoc.rs:979, `ciphertext_3.0` contains ciphertext after `encrypt_in_place_detached`, but the transcript must be over plaintext. The responder side (line 1422) and unit test (line 1712) correctly use plaintext. This causes TH_4 mismatch between initiator and responder, which in turn corrupts OSCORE context derivation — peers will fail to communicate. Fix: save CIPHERTEXT_3 plaintext before AEAD encryption and pass that to transcript_4.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:23:55.999376509Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:23:55.999376509Z"}
